cards.card_text: Now a blessing: "Blessed are those who wash their robes…" And friend, this blessing comes with something BIG.
cards.verse_text: Blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city by its gates.

cards.card_text: Those who wash their robes get the right to something.
